summary.en-US: Fill job application forms from your saved profile, attach your CV, and draft cover letters with Gemini.

description.en-US:
Apply Filler helps you complete job applications faster.

• Matches common form fields from your local profile (name, email, salary prefs, and more)
• Optionally drafts cover letters and open questions with your free Gemini API key
• Can auto-attach a resume you imported in Options
• Never submits forms for you — always review before sending

Your profile stays in browser storage. Vacancy text and open-question labels are sent to Google Gemini only when you set an API key and those fields need answers.

version.approval_notes:
Uses pdfjs-dist and mammoth only on the Options page to parse resumes locally. Function constructor / dynamic import warnings come from those third-party parsers, not from the content script fill path.

This submission is for the public (listed) channel. Same add-on ID as the existing unlisted build (apply-filler@local.dev).
